Former Cricketer Questions India's T20 Squad Selection for Afghanistan Series

Former Indian cricketer S. Badrinath has questioned the selection of the Indian squad for the upcoming T20 series against Afghanistan. Badrinath specifically raised concerns about the consistent selection of Washington Sundar, whom he referred to as a 'coach's favorite.' He also expressed doubts regarding the inclusion of Nitish Kumar Reddy in the team. The former player's comments suggest dissatisfaction with the team's composition for the series.
